svg.title: Reading the NaOH enthalpy–concentration chart (Foust Fig. 19.13)
svg.text: Reading the NaOH enthalpy–concentration chart (Foust Fig. 19.13)
NaOH–H₂O enthalpy–concentration chart (after McCabe), redrawn; isotherms every 20 °F; right: zooms
zoom: feed 5 % at 80 °F; effect-II liquor 8.9 % at 105.7 °F
Feed 5 % at 80 °F: up from 5 % to the 80 °F isotherm, across to the axis: h_F ≈ 45 Btu/lb (1 → 4).
Effect-II liquor 8.9 % at 105.7 °F: up to the 105.7 °F isotherm (dashed, interpolated), across: h₂ ≈ 68 (5 → 8).
Product 50 % at 251 °F: up to the 251 °F isotherm (dashed), across: h₁ ≈ 264 Btu/lb (9 → 12).
Interpolate isotherms between the printed 20 °F lines by eye, as on the printed chart.
Hollow circle: this redraw’s value where it differs visibly from the solution’s reading.
Redrawn from the printed chart (digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
